body:
**Merged with "Live agent activity" (2026-10-04, at the person's request).** Revision 2.

- **Sprint 1, Agents:** the 16 tickets that were this epic's three sprints (DM-46 to DM-61), then the sprint 1 Fireguard ticket (DM-102) and the acceptance node (DM-104).
- **Sprint 2, Live agent activity:** copies of the 11 Live activity tickets (old DM-62 to DM-72, now DM-91 to DM-101, in the same order), then the sprint 2 Fireguard ticket (DM-103) and the acceptance node (DM-90). The only text changes are two mentions of "the Agents epic", which now name sprint 1 tickets (DM-96, DM-100). The old sprint 2 entry criterion about the Agents epic was dropped. Its dependency is now these edges: DM-53→DM-96, DM-54/DM-55→DM-97, DM-59→DM-98.
- **Checkpoints:** both are `auto`. They pass without a stop only if auto-continue is authorized for the run in the desktop app.
- The size field is now set on every ticket, from the size written in its body.
- The original "Live agent activity" epic (ep_01m418epbnpgc4xt6kbw6ccsz8) is superseded. MCP can't delete epics, so it stays in Backlog until it's deleted in the desktop app.
